stem.text: The compound *aspartame* is widely used as a sweetener in ‘diet’ soft drinks.

stem.alt: Structural formula of aspartame, labelled aspartame: a HO-C(=O) acid group, an NH2 group, an amide C(=O)NH group, a methyl ester C(=O)OCH3 group and a C6H5 group.

stem.text: Aspartame is chiral. (There are no chiral carbon atoms in $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5$.)
How many chiral carbon atoms are present in a molecule of *aspartame*?
